alex rodriguez: Hey all first day here! Quick list: HubSpot seat, Aircall extension, where to find one-pagers and competitive notes, and any recommended voicemail script? Trying to get calls ready by EOW.

maria (sales-ops): welcome alex! I started ticket SO-9003 for HubSpot and AC-9004 for Aircall. HubSpot needs your corporate email + full name (exactly as it appears in Okta). Aircall asks for preferred outbound caller ID and timezone.

it-team: @alex rodriguez provide laptop name and mac address if you want device-based provisioning. For HubSpot SSO make sure you're logged into Okta first.

alex rodriguez: sent email & full name via DM. Laptop is ALEX-MBP-07. Also can someone link the updated battlecards?

rachel enablement: Battlecards and one-pagers are in Notion: https://notion.redwood/sales/collateral (search "battlecards"). Quick links: 1-pager (integrations): https://notion.redwood/sales/1pagers/integrations-v3, battlecards folder: https://notion.redwood/sales/battlecards. Use "Call Opener" script on slide 3 of demo_deck_v4.

sam manager: Welcome Alex! Week 1 plan: Mon/Tue shadowing, Wed role-play, Thurs start 2 live discovery calls. I'll pair you with Priya for shadowing. Ping me if you want extra demo practice.

onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/alex-rodriguez Status: HubSpot (pending), Aircall (pending), HR forms (complete).

maria (sales-ops): HubSpot seat provisioned 705. You should see the Sales pipeline and contacts in ~5min. Aircall is queued; agent creation ETA 2 hours.

alex rodriguez: HubSpot visible, thanks! Any standard voicemail script? Prefer concise.

rachel enablement: Short script: "Hi, you've reached Alex at Redwood Inference. Leave name and number and I'll follow up within one business day. For urgent issues email alex@redwood.com." Also copy/paste for dialpad/aircall: `Hi, this is Alex from Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you, please leave a short message and I will follow up.`

maria (sales-ops): Aircall seat active 705 and shared inbox created (sales-east). Let us know if calls show as missed in HubSpot.

alex rodriguez: Got everything. One last: are there short objection-handling snippets for price and security?

rachel enablement: Yes  price: "I get that. Most customers see ROI within X months; can I share a case study?" Security: "We offer private deploy options + SOC2; happy to connect you with our security brief." I'll DM the two-snippet pack. :sparkles:

alex rodriguez: Amazing, thanks everyone  excited to get started :raised_hands:
